title: ExecutionAttempt
description: Records an attempted execution of a plan item against a specific build. Binds the attempt to an immutable plan_item_id + probe_definition_hash. Presentation row text does not establish probe identity here — only plan_item_id and probe_definition_hash do.

plan_hash.description: Hash of the EvaluationPlan this attempt is bound to.

plan_item_id.description: Identifies the specific plan item this attempt satisfies.

probe_definition_hash.description: The immutable probe identity. Must match the plan_item's probe_definition_hash — a mismatch blocks satisfaction.

target_build_id.description: Must match the plan's target_build_id exactly. A mismatch means this attempt cannot satisfy the plan.

execution_record_ref.description: record_hash of the ProbeExecutionRecord this attempt is grounded in.

execution_state.description: Execution state drawn from the linked execution record. Not_run is not valid — an attempt record implies execution was performed.
